card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 14 That Randomly Restarts

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 14 That Randomly Restarts

claims.statement: iPhone 14 / 14 Plus SMC panic Sensor Array: 0x400000 (4194304) = wireless charging flex on the back glass; 0x100000 (1048576) = charging port flex; 0x200000 (2097152) = proximity flex; 0x600000 = wireless charging + prox.
0x500000 (5242880) is listed as battery communication (restart about every 3.5 min) or as Taptic Engine plus charge port flex.
0x20000 (131072) = logic board interposer disconnection; inspect board edges for layer gaps.
Codes are hex bit flags and can combine into values not listed.

procedure: Read the Sensor Array value; split it into flags.
Test each flagged flex with a known-good OEM part; diode-check FPCs.
For 0x500000 test a known-good battery and the Taptic/charge port flex.
For 0x20000 inspect and repair the interposer.
card.caveats: 0x500000 has two different explanations on the source page. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
card.component: Back glass / charge port / prox flex
